Every dividend in the record from the March 13, 2026 payment onward is $0.12 per share. The two earlier payments in the record were larger, at $0.36 per share on January 23, 2026 and $0.34 per share on October 24, 2025. The record does not hold every regular dividend of the past year, so this page gives no yearly total.


All amounts on this page are per share and before any tax. As of November 16, 2026, Invesco Mortgage Capital has not announced its next dividend, and this page is updated when the company declares it.
